description: A customizable tooltip component used to create tooltips with different content. The tooltip can be dismissed by pressing the Escape key when hovering over it. When forceOpen is enabled, the tooltip will remain open and can only be closed by setting forceOpen to false. Use the contentElement prop to supply rich HTML content to the tooltip such as multiline text. For plain dynamic text, prefer the content prop instead. When contentElement is set, it takes precedence over the content prop.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The text content of the tooltip. When contentElement is also set, contentElement takes precedence.

properties.name: contentElement
properties.description: An optional rich HTML element to render as the tooltip body. When set, this takes precedence over the `content` string prop. The element is deep-cloned into the tooltip container.

properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the inner div.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables displaying the tooltip on hover

properties.name: forceOpen
properties.description: Use this attribute to force the tooltip to remain open.

properties.name: tooltipId
properties.description: The ID of the tooltip element, useful for setting the "aria-describedby" attribute of related elements.

properties.name: position
properties.description: The position that the tooltip will render in relation to the element.

events.name: dismissEscape
events.description: An event that fires when the tooltip is dismissed via Escape key
